calls.reason: Only two examples, Chromium's sandbox policies and LibreOffice's conversion libraries, are offered. Nothing covers the wider software population, so 'virtually all' cannot be judged.
AlphaZero beating Stockfish is one domain, and the AI Index abstract gives no cross-domain comparison. The evidence cannot show a majority of domains either way.

The Gato report says harm safeguards are underdeveloped but also shows basic language abilities. No evaluation tests understanding, alignment or mission-critical reliability, so the five-part claim stays unsettled.
A February 2022 COGS study found seq2seq models, BART included, near zero on structural generalization, so nets did have trouble. The 2019 symbolic-maths success only qualifies a stronger claim.
The compute-trends study and PaLM announcement show scaling was rising and prominent. Neither compares it with other research directions, so predominance is not established.
